stories.title: After 15-year delay, BMC clears 27 structures for road widening in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Tuesday demolished 27 structures that had been obstructing a long-pending road-widening project at the Mathuradas Road-Swami Vivekanand Road junction in Kandivali West. The demolition drive was carried out by the civic body's R-South Ward under its 'Pedestrian First' campaign, which aims to make footpaths more accessible to pedestrians by removing encroachments and clearing roads.

stories.title: Mumbai Shocker: 52-Year-Old Carpenter Injured After Passenger Hurls Knife At Fellow Commuter During Altercation On Train | Video

stories.title: Man arrested for allegedly killing acquaintance over unpaid mobile loan
stories.summary: A man allegedly killed his 23-year-old acquaintance following a dispute over unpaid mobile loan instalments and dumped the body in bushes at a village in Navi Mumbai, police said on Wednesday. Officials said that the incident occurred last week. They also added that the accused, identified as Pratik Mohan Jadhav (30), a resident of Panvel in Navi Mumbai, was arrested on Monday, as per PTI.

stories.summary: 5 lakh for individual weapons and sanctioning powers extending to ₹1 crore. The decision was taken at a Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.summary: An FIR registered on November 11 invokes IPC Sections 404 (misappropriation of deceased’s property), 406 (criminal breach of trust), 420 (cheating), 465, 467 and 468 (forgery) and 471 (using forged documents). stories.title: Mumbai: Five bikers arrested for performing dangerous stunts on WEH
stories.summary: Mumbai Police have arrested five bikers for allegedly performing dangerous stunts, driving recklessly and creating a public nuisance on the Western Express Highway (WEH) . stories.title: Kate Middleton Wears Late Queen Elizabeth's Emerald Tassel Necklace For The First Time At Mumbai's Earthshot Prize With Prince William
stories.summary: Whenever Kate Middleton gets the chance to bring a piece of royal history back into the spotlight, she rarely lets it pass, and we definitely have no complaints. stories.title: Mumbai car dealer's trade certificate suspended over Ferrari delivery

According to the Transport Commissioner’s office, a Navnit Motors outlet in Bandra delivered a red Ferrari to its owner on October 13, before completing its registration formalities, in violation of prescribed rules.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested for demanding Rs 1 lakh from Nanded businessman
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. Officials said that the accused threatened the victim with a claim that he had previously plotted to kill a former Maharashtra Chief Minister and four MLAs from the district, as per PTI.

stories.title: Missing three-year-old boy found dead in Andheri drain after three-day search
stories.summary: The body of a three-year-old boy, who had gone missing from the DN Nagar area on November 14, was found floating in a drain in Andheri West on Tuesday, bringing a tragic end to the search for the child. Preliminary investigations suggest that he may have accidentally fallen into the drain and drowned.

stories.title: Dawood Ibrahim's Ancestral Home In Mumbai's Bhendi Bazaar To Be Demolished By BMC | Video
stories.summary: Mumbai: A building in south Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, identified as the ancestral home of fugitive underworld figure Dawood Ibrahim, was partially demolished by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday. stories.title: Shivaji Maharaj’s Historic Vagh Nakh Goes on Display at Mumbai Museum
stories.summary: Mumbaikars can now witness the historic Vagh Nakh (tiger claw weapon) associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his legendary encounter with Afzal Khan in 1659. The centuries-old weapon has gone on public display at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS) in South Mumbai as part of a special exhibition titled ‘Shivshastra Shauryagatha’.

stories.title: Subordinate court staff go on indefinite strike over pay parity
stories.summary: Around 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff. The strike disrupted work in courts across Mumbai, with hundreds of employees gathering outside the Sessions Court in Fort. The agitation has been called by four major associations representing subordinate court employees.

stories.title: IndiGo aircraft grounded after bird hit at Navi Mumbai airport
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Mangaluru reported a bird hit on arrival at Navi Mumbai International Airport on Tuesday, following which the aircraft was grounded for inspection, a PTI source said.
